name: workbench
summary: The one built-in view: what the knowledge base knows (Overview; Knowledge: the graph as pages to browse and search, each thing with its history and evidence, and as a graph), the ontology (classes, rules, lexicon, dependencies, versions), where the project is (Project: its stations) and the work.
